title: Advanced Professional Certificate In Mental Health and Risk - Building Resilient People And Systems
description: Equip professionals with essential skills to manage mental health challenges and strengthen organizational resilience through effective risk strategies.
university: The Global School of Skills (GSS) and Australian University
longDescription: This course explores the intersection of mental health and risk management in professional environments. Participants will learn how mental health issues impact organizational stability and how to build resilience at both individual and systemic levels. The course covers operational and strategic risk frameworks, well-being management, and business continuity planning. Video resources and case-based learning enhance the understanding of stress triggers and intervention strategies. A focus on ethical responsibility and sustainable practices underpins the program’s approach to long-term resilience.
courseDetails: The programme includes interactive modules, case studies, and expert-led video lectures on mental health and risk topics. Key areas include operational risk, strategic risk, mental health support systems, and stress mitigation. Participants will explore ethical dimensions and integrate corporate social responsibility in managing risk. Designed for professionals in HR, health and safety, compliance, and leadership roles.

modules.title: Mental Health And Risk - Building Resilient People And Systems
modules.summary: Explore the connection between mental health and organizational risk, focusing on strategies to foster resilience in individuals and systems for sustainable workplace performance.

lessons.title: 5 Triggers of Mental Health Disorder in the workplace
Mental Health Disorder And Well-Being Management
Three-step System to Combating Mental Health Disorder
Understanding the concept of Operational Risk
Standards And Approaches Of Operational Risks
Integrating Corporate Social Responsibility and Ethics in Risk Management

outcomes: Identify and explain the five key triggers of mental health disorders related to stress, and assess their impact on individual and workplace well-being.
Understand the principles and scope of operational risk, including its causes, consequences, and relevance to organizational stability.
Evaluate various standards and frameworks for managing operational risks, including industry best practices and compliance guidelines.
Demonstrate foundational knowledge of strategic risk management, with emphasis on aligning risk strategy with business objectives.
Apply appropriate risk management strategies and measures to mitigate both anticipated and emerging risks in diverse organizational contexts.
Analyze the relationship between mental health disorders and overall well-being, and explore practical methods for effective management and support.
Implement the three-step system to combating stress-related mental health issues, enhancing both individual resilience and organizational support systems.
Assess the integration of corporate social responsibility and ethical principles into risk management practices, and explain their role in sustainable business operations and continuity planning.
